question: Para saan ang Certificate of Compatibility sa CPDO, magkano ang bayad, at gaano kabilis makuha?
answer:
Para sa Certificate of Compatibility sa CPDO (City Planning and Development Office), wala nga nakit-an nga bayad sa mga nakapag-aral sa Citizens' Charter. Ang mabilis nga makuha nga Certificate of Compatibility, mao nga wala nga nakit-an nga specific na oras sa mga nakapag-aral. [S1]

For the Certificate of Compatibility in CPDO (City Planning and Development Office), there is no specified fee mentioned in the Citizens' Charter. The speed of obtaining the Certificate of Compatibility is not specified in the sources. [S1]

ground_truth:
The Certificate of Compatibility certifies uses or land activities capable of existing together harmoniously. Checklist: Application Letter, Zoning Certificate from CPDO, and Official Receipt from CTO.

Filing fee is PHP300. The stated TOTAL is 1 Hour and 20 Minutes. The initial/final signature step is 15 minutes depending on availability of the Acting Zoning Administrator.
